
```{bash}
samtools faidx ../data/GCF_016432855.1_SaNama_1.0_genomic.fa
cut -f1,2 ../data/GCF_016432855.1_SaNama_1.0_genomic.fa.fai > ../analyses/05-pacbio-align/ref.chrom.sizes
bedGraphToBigWig ../analyses/05-pacbio-align/bc2068.CpG.bedGraph \

                 ../analyses/05-pacbio-align/bc2068.CpG.bw
```
